marta: Quick report from the reranker bring-up: v4-alpha (fp16) on holdout-2026-03-01: NDCG@10=0.768 MRR=0.419. After PTQ int8 with our default per-channel config NDCG@10=0.755 MRR=0.412.
alex: Is that delta statistically significant? Did you run bootstrap CIs?
marta: Yep. Bootstrap 10k resamples on 5k queries: unquant NDCG 0.768 (95% CI 0.764-0.772), int8 0.755 (95% CI 0.751-0.759). CIs don't overlap.
raj: Hmm. What's the sampling protocol? uniform over queries or weighted by query freq?
marta: uniform. I also did a freq-weighted run: delta similar but slightly smaller.
sophie: Any changes in preprocessing/priming recently? Even small separators can move token offsets for long docs.
marta: We toggled priming anchor prompts for the candidate pool in PR 821 (added "Context:" token). Could be relevant.
ale x: (typo) alex: Also check candidate pruning; different pruning heuristics can change candidate distributions and amplify metric shifts.
marta: Candidate prune unchanged; same pipeline. I ran top-k diffs between fp16 and int8: 2.8% of queries had top1 flips, 7.1% had any change in top5 ordering.
raj: Can you slice by query intent/length? If flips concentrate in a slice that's actionable.
marta: Sliced by doc-length and intent: 74% of top1 flips are long-doc (>1500 tokens) and 60% are informational-intent queries.
eval-bot: scheduled: rerun-pertensor-sweep job 5210 queued. link: https://ci/5210
alex: Good. Also try symmetric vs affine quant and per-tensor vs per-channel. Per-tensor sometimes reduces distributed error for long sequences.
marta: I'm running per-tensor symmetric now on 1k quick sample.
... (5m)
marta: quick 1k results: fp16 NDCG@10 0.769 MRR 0.420; int8 per-channel NDCG@10 0.753 MRR 0.411; int8 per-tensor symmetric NDCG@10 0.758 MRR 0.415.
sophie: That suggests per-tensor helps but doesn't fully close gap. Can we look at score calibration? Maybe a rescale per-batch or temperature on logits helps.
raj: Add per-query score delta histogram and CDF. If median small but heavy negative tail then a post-hoc rescale might help for production.
marta: Pushed artifacts: https://artifacts/repro/309876. Median delta -0.002, 95th pctile -0.07.
alex: If long docs dominate, consider special quant path (higher precision for kv layers) or reverting kvpack for long-doc batches.
sophie: Also flag runtime: ensure kvpack layout and rounding are identical between builds; I've seen minor ABI changes that shift accumulation order.
 nmarta: Action items: 1) raj -> per-query delta + slice CDF, 2) alex -> PTQ sweep (per-tensor/symmetric/affine), 3) sophie -> runtime kvpack invariants. I will open INF-1312 with repro sample and attach small 200-query set that shows top1 flips.
eval-bot: note: job 5210 started, ETA ~2h. :gear:
raj: I'll post a short CSV with top-k diffs and doc-length buckets when done.
marta: Thanks team. If any config shows <0.004 NDCG drop with comparable MRR, we can consider keeping quant but gate for long-doc traffic.
sophie: FYI I'm adding a telemetry flag to record doc-length per inference in staging so we can measure live impact once canary deployed.
eval-bot: reminder: this thread will be archived in 30 days.
